tests.name: Release Contract
expected_outputs: release contract and all declared version sources agree
test catalog is complete and structurally valid
update catalog, update journal, compatibility and build manifest formats are valid
tests.run_rule: every pull request and release build
tests.invalidation_rule: invalidate when release.json, a declared version source, test catalog, build scripts, installer scripts or release workflow changes

tests.name: Update Core Unit
expected_outputs: canonical JSON and SemVer checks pass
Ed25519 tamper, trust, expiry, sequence, downgrade, URL and compatibility defenses pass
atomic journal transitions and recovery decisions pass
tests.run_rule: every pull request and release build
tests.invalidation_rule: invalidate when updater core, catalog schema, trust store, journal schema or release compatibility changes

tests.name: Update Downloader Unit
expected_outputs: interrupted payload resumes with a valid HTTP range
size, SHA-256, scheme and host violations are rejected
completed payload is atomically promoted from the partial file
tests.run_rule: every pull request and release build
tests.invalidation_rule: invalidate when downloader, catalog URL policy, retry policy or payload verification changes

tests.name: Update Controller Unit
expected_outputs: disabled, current, staged rollout and available-update decisions pass
verified catalog persists and survives controller restart
download failure is recorded safely and can be retried as a new operation
signed halt cancels a downloaded build and signed rollback is limited to named installed versions
after-close and remind-later choices persist without exposing a machine identifier
tests.run_rule: every pull request and release build
tests.invalidation_rule: invalidate when UpdateController, policy, downloader, journal or catalog validation changes

tests.name: Update UI Unit
expected_outputs: disabled, idle, available, downloading, ready, applying and failed states render correctly
download progress, release summary, size, last check, history and safe diagnostic id are rendered
restart-now, after-close and remind-later choices are exercised
signature failures are shown in plain language and remain fail-closed
tests.run_rule: every pull request and release build
tests.invalidation_rule: invalidate when update UI, preload update bridge, controller status or update settings markup changes

tests.name: Update Catalog Worker Unit
expected_outputs: only GET and HEAD catalog routes are accepted
stored catalog bytes, channel, size and shape are checked before serving
ETag, revalidation and fail-closed responses are exercised
tests.run_rule: every pull request and update catalog service deployment
tests.invalidation_rule: invalidate when the catalog Worker, KV binding, route or response policy changes

tests.name: Update Catalog Operations Unit
expected_outputs: private and public Ed25519 keys must match
catalog sequence and immutable backup keys are validated
stable rollout cannot skip or regress the 5 and 25 percent stages
halt and rollback directives must identify the currently published release
tests.run_rule: every pull request and update catalog publication
tests.invalidation_rule: invalidate when signing, publication, backup, rollback or rollout policy changes

tests.name: Update Helper Runner Unit
expected_outputs: installed helper hash is verified before its isolated copy is launched
operation plan uses fixed download, staging, previous and health paths and binds the installed source version
helper launch never uses a shell or renderer-supplied command
tests.run_rule: every pull request and release build
tests.invalidation_rule: invalidate when update plan, helper identity, helper runner or apply orchestration changes

tests.name: Windows Update Helper Self Test
expected_outputs: canonical JSON and Ed25519 self-test pass
tamper, path traversal, atomic state and SHA-256 self-tests pass
transactional file replacement and simulated health-confirmation rollback restore the previous version
publish emits a self-contained single-file Windows helper
tests.run_rule: every Windows payload and installer build
tests.invalidation_rule: invalidate when Update Helper source, NuGet lock, embedded trust store, build identity or Windows toolchain changes

tests.name: Update Payload Identity
expected_outputs: helper byte count and SHA-256 inside protected app.asar match the shipped PE
shipped helper has a Windows PE header
tests.run_rule: every Windows payload and installer build
tests.invalidation_rule: invalidate when payload assembly, ASAR protection, helper build or helper identity changes

tests.name: Build Manifest
expected_outputs: manifest identity equals the exact release contract and commit
source archive, lockfiles, payload and Windows artifact hashes match
tests.run_rule: every Windows payload and installer build
tests.invalidation_rule: invalidate when release identity, manifest schema, payload, installer, lockfile, source archive or hashing logic changes

tests.name: Release Evidence Unit
expected_outputs: npm and NuGet locks produce SPDX 2.3 packages
evidence output cannot erase the .release root
canonical release artifacts, checksums and NO-GO status assemble together
tests.run_rule: every pull request and release build
tests.invalidation_rule: invalidate when SBOM, checksum, evidence packaging or release artifact naming changes

tests.name: Windows Native 783
tests.command: GitHub Actions: Windows native release gate
expected_outputs: protected payload and native installer are built from the exact checked-out commit
installer, recovery, visual and destructive-operation acceptance pass
tests.run_rule: every pull request that affects release, application, desktop-runtime or installer contracts and every protected main commit
tests.invalidation_rule: invalidate on any source, lockfile, workflow, payload, installer, test or release-contract change
